items.effect: approximated: flattened, the placeholder keeps the position and size it inherits as its own
items.label: placeholder(s) that take their position from the layout (flattened on import)

items.effect: approximated: the stored font scale and line spacing reduction are applied as written; line breaks may differ from PowerPoint
items.label: text box(es) that shrink or resize to fit their text

items.effect: approximated: kept, drawn at a reduced size shifted by the stored percent (PowerPoint's size change differs by font)
items.label: run(s) raised or lowered (superscript, subscript)

items.effect: approximated: bullet character, colour, size and numbering are kept; bullet fonts and numbering schemes beyond arabic, alpha and roman are not
items.label: paragraph(s) with custom bullets or numbering

items.effect: lost: not imported (the PPTX reader does not read this yet)
items.label: paragraph(s) with picture bullets

items.effect: approximated: the column count and spacing are kept; shrink-to-fit measures the balanced height
items.label: text box(es) with several columns

items.effect: approximated: character spacing and capitalisation are kept; small caps are the browser's
items.label: run(s) with character spacing or capitalisation

items.effect: approximated: tab stops are kept, but the editor lays out default tabs
items.label: paragraph(s) with tab stops

items.effect: approximated: the text direction is kept and drawn by the browser
items.label: text box(es) or cell(s) with vertical text
